text: Overnight, Gavin Newsom's price climbed 0.9 points to 10.4, the largest change on the board. Both books agreed on the direction, with Kalshi moving 1.1 points and Polymarket 0.7 points. The odds that Rahm Emanuel enters the race rose 21 points on Kalshi, to 91 percent, even though Emanuel's nomination price barely moved. The model went along, and Newsom now wins 21 percent of simulated primaries, against 20 the day before. The markets have Jon Ossoff on top at 23. In our simulations it's AOC, first in 31 percent of runs. In 11 percent of those runs nobody reaches the convention with a pledged majority. Tonight's prices will show whether the Newsom move holds.
